decisions.reason: Connector clearance and spacing on the Power Board do not change the established three-board architecture.
The source adds mechanical placement constraints owned by the Power Board form-factor Requirement; it does not change the battery connector's NTC contact or required connection access.
Mechanical clearance between connectors and mounting holes does not alter battery protection, cutoff, or thermal-sensing behavior.
The Power Board connector-placement constraints do not change the charge-status indication path on the Main Board.
The source constrains connector placement and spacing, not connector sourcing, availability, or compatible-alternative policy.
Power Board mounting-hole clearance and connector spacing do not affect ESP32 sleep modes or wake behavior.
The mechanical connector constraints do not change I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
Connector clearance and spacing do not change the switched 5V rail's GPIO control, default state, converter, or operating pattern.
